meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aX7fZcp3SK6_EzubC_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Configuration:
    title: Configuration
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Loads configuration variables for observable types to enrich and alert SLA hours from assets
    on-success:
    - Prepare_Fields: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Observable_Types_to_Enrich
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
    - name: Alert_SLA_Hours
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_General_Configuration.SLA_Hours.Alert
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 934fa74e-0539-4df8-a9e5-741809ec93db
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 115a8b44-38ce-4772-8ad5-eebb9123e76c
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Prepare_Fields:
    meta: {}
    title: Prepare Fields
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Upsert_CASE_Record: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Transforms and extracts alert data including timestamps, MITRE tactics, rule info, and observables into structured fields
    transformations:
      alert_start_timestamp:
        title: Alert Start Timestamp
        inputs:
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_start_timestamp:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_start_timestamp
          expression: 'inputs.alert.alert_start_timestamp ? inputs.alert.alert_start_timestamp : ""'
        next: alert_end_timestamp
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
      alert_end_timestamp:
        title: Alert End Timestamp
        inputs:
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_end_timestamp:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_end_timestamp
          expression: 'inputs.alert.alert_end_timestamp ? inputs.alert.alert_end_timestamp : ""'
        next: alert_created_timestamp
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
      alert_created_timestamp:
        title: Alert Created Timestamp
        inputs:
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_created_timestamp:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_created_timestamp
          expression: 'inputs.alert.alert_created_timestamp ? inputs.alert.alert_created_timestamp : ""'
        next: alert_ingested_timestamp
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
      alert_ingested_timestamp:
        title: Alert Ingested Timestamp
        inputs:
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_ingested_timestamp:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_ingested_timestamp
          expression: 'inputs.alert.alert_ingested_timestamp ? inputs.alert.alert_ingested_timestamp : $now()'
        next: mitre_attck_tacticstechniques
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
      mitre_attck_tacticstechniques:
        title: MITRE ATT&CK Tactics/Techniques
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: "(\n  $tactics_present := inputs.alert.alert_mitre_attack_tactic_technique.($map(tactics.name, function($v) { $v & \" / \" & technique.name})) ;\n  \n  $tactics_absent := inputs.alert.alert_mitre_attack_tactic_technique.($map($, function($v){ $count($v.tactics) = 0 ? technique.name } )) ;\n    \n  $merged_tactics := $append($tactics_present, $tactics_absent) ;\n)"
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_mitre_attack_tactic_technique:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_mitre_attack_tactic_technique
        actionType: jsonata
        next: rule_ids
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      rule_ids:
        title: Rule IDs
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules
            - rule_id
          - function: arrayForce
            inputs: []
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(inputs.alert.alert_rules,'rule_id') ~> $arrayForce()
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_rules:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules
        actionType: jsonata
        next: rule_descriptions
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      rule_descriptions:
        title: Rule Descriptions
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules
            - rule_description
          - function: arrayForce
            inputs: []
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(inputs.alert.alert_rules,'rule_description') ~> $arrayForce()
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_rules:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules
        actionType: jsonata
        next: rule_names
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      rule_names:
        title: Rule Names
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules
            - rule_name
          - function: arrayForce
            inputs: []
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(inputs.alert.alert_rules,'rule_name') ~> $arrayForce()
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                alert_rules:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules
        actionType: jsonata
        next: observables_value_array
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      observables_value_array:
        title: Observables Value Array
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $inputs.alert.observables
            - observable_value
          - function: arrayForce
            inputs: []
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(inputs.alert.observables,'observable_value') ~> $arrayForce()
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                observables:
                  $:ref: $inputs.alert.observables
        actionType: jsonata
        next: extended_fields_exist
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      extended_fields_exist:
        title: Extended Fields Exist
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
                $ext := inputs.Extended_Alert_Fields;

                $count($keys($ext)) > 0 ? true : false ;
            )
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                $:ref: $inputs.alert
              Extended_Alert_Fields:
                $:ref: $inputs.Extended_Alert_Fields
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: alert_start_timestamp
  If_Extended_Keys_Exist:
    title: If Extended Keys Exist
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Checks whether additional extended alert fields are present in the input
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Upsert_CASE_Record_With_Extended_Fields
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.extended_fields_exist
          - $:eq: true
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 0e0cf85a-cc29-4e63-b510-f1671892b135
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Upsert_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Upsert CASE Record
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - If_Extended_Keys_Exist: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Creates or updates a CASE record with standardized alert data and metadata
    inputSchemaReferenceId: d657ede5-730a-4acb-85ce-46929b8a24f8
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      keyFieldKey: alert-uid
      keyFieldValue: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_uid }'
      patchValues:
        alert-raw-json: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.raw_alert }'
        alert-risk-score:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_risk_score
        alert-name: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_title }'
        alert-description: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_description }'
        alert-permalink: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_permalink }'
        alert-categories:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_categories
        alert-severity: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_severity }'
        alert-rules: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_rules }'
        alert-rule-names:
          $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.rule_names
        alert-rule-ids:
          $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.rule_ids
        alert-uid: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_uid }'
        signal-name: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_title }'
        signal-type: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Type }'
        signal-description: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_description }'
        signal-source: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Source }'
        mitre-attack-techniques:
          $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.mitre_attck_tacticstechniques
        signal-impacted-users:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_impacted_usernames
        signal-impacted-assets:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_impacted_hostnames
        signal-impacted-ip-addresses:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_impacted_ip_addresses
        threat-intelligence-reference:
          $:ref: $inputs.Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs
        knowledge-base-articles-reference:
          $:ref: $inputs.KB_Article_Tracking_IDs
        observables:
          $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.observables_value_array
        organization: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_organization }'
        severity: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_severity }'
        organization-id: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_organization_id }'
        mitre-d3fend-techniques:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.mitre_d3fend_techniques
        alert-command-line-commands: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_command_line_commands }'
        alert-entities:
          $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_entities
        alert-host-criticality: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_host_criticality }'
        alert-host-id: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_host_id }'
        alert-host-data-raw: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_host_data_raw }'
        alert-supporting-evidence: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_supporting_evidence }'
        alert-user-data-raw: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_user_data_raw }'
        time-of-first-evidence: '{ $:ref: $inputs.alert.alert_created_timestamp }'
        sla-total-hours:
          $:ref: $variables.Alert_SLA_Hours
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: upsert
  Upsert_CASE_Record_With_Extended_Fields:
    meta: {}
    title: Upsert CASE Record With Extended Fields
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Updates the CASE record with any provided extended alert fields via patch operation
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $actions.Upsert_CASE_Record.result['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        $:ref: $inputs.Extended_Alert_Fields
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Configuration
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  SIG_Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $actions.Upsert_CASE_Record.result['tracking-id'] }"
environment: {}
triggers: {}

outputSchemaReferenceId: a0acd2b1-bb4c-45f7-9af5-a091381200fb
